story.text: 쉬는 날, 하늘은 평소 안 쓰던 야구모자를 눌러쓰고 마스크까지 챙겨 집을 나섰다. 거울 속 자신을 보며 그는 잠깐 멈칫했다.
story.reading: swi-neun nal, ha-neul-eun pyeong-so an sseu-deon ya-gu-mo-ja-reul nul-leo-sseu-go ma-seu-keu-kka-ji chaeng-gyeo jib-eul na-seoss-da. geo-ul sog ja-sin-eul bo-myeo geu-neun jam-kkan meom-chit-haess-da.
story.en: On his day off, Haneul pulled a baseball cap low over his eyes — one he never normally wore — and grabbed a mask before heading out. He paused for a moment, looking at himself in the mirror.

story.text: '…이게 뭐 하는 짓이지.' 낮게 중얼거리면서도, 그는 발걸음을 멈추지 않았다. 스스로도 어이없는 변장이라고 생각하면서.
story.reading: '…i-ge mwo ha-neun jis-i-ji.' naj-ge jung-eol-geo-ri-myeon-seo-do, geu-neun bal-geol-eum-eul meom-chu-ji anh-ass-da. seu-seu-ro-do eo-i-eobs-neun byeon-jang-i-ra-go saeng-gag-ha-myeon-seo.
story.en: '...What am I even doing.' He muttered under his breath, but his feet kept moving anyway — even as he thought his own disguise was faintly ridiculous.

story.text: 서점 앞에는 이미 긴 줄이 늘어서 있었다. 오늘, 이곳에서 그녀의 팬사인회가 열린다는 걸 그는 우연히 알게 됐다.
story.reading: seo-jeom ap-e-neun i-mi gin jul-i neul-eo-seo iss-eoss-da. o-neul, i-gos-e-seo geu-nyeo-ui paen-sa-in-hoe-ga yeol-lin-da-neun geol geu-neun u-yeon-hi al-ge dwaess-da.
story.en: A long line had already formed in front of the bookstore. He'd found out, entirely by chance, that her fan-signing event was being held there today.

story.text: 태어나서 처음 서보는 줄이었다. 앞에 선 사람이 응원봉을 흔들며 말했다. '저 세 시간 전부터 기다렸어요!' 하늘은 그 열정에 조용히 압도됐다.
story.reading: tae-eo-na-seo cheo-eum seo-bo-neun jul-i-eoss-da. ap-e seon sa-ram-i eung-won-bong-eul heun-deul-myeo mal-haess-da. 'jeo se si-gan jeon-bu-teo gi-da-ryeoss-eo-yo!' ha-neul-eun geu yeol-jeong-e jo-yong-hi ab-do-dwaess-da.
story.en: It was the first line he'd ever stood in, in his entire life. The person ahead of him was waving a light stick. 'I've been waiting since three hours ago!' Haneul was quietly overwhelmed by that kind of devotion.

story.text: 드디어 차례가 왔을 때, 그는 뭐라 말해야 할지 몰라 그저 어색하게 서 있었다. '…어, 저기…' 평소의 그답지 않게 말을 더듬었다.
story.reading: deu-di-eo cha-rye-ga wass-eul ttae, geu-neun mwo-ra mal-hae-ya hal-ji mol-la geu-jeo eo-saeg-ha-ge seo iss-eoss-da. '…eo, jeo-gi…' pyeong-so-ui geu-dap-ji anh-ge mal-eul deo-deum-eoss-da.
story.en: When his turn finally came, he had no idea what to say and just stood there, painfully awkward. '...Um, so...' He stammered, entirely unlike his usual self.

story.text: 마스크 너머로 자신을 알아본 손님이 눈을 크게 떴다. '…여긴 어떻게…' 하늘은 시선을 피하며 앨범을 내밀었다. '사인이나 좀, 해줘요.'
story.reading: ma-seu-keu neo-meo-ro ja-sin-eul al-a-bon son-nim-i nun-eul keu-ge tteoss-da. '…yeo-gin eo-tteoh-ge…' ha-neul-eun si-seon-eul pi-ha-myeo ael-beom-eul nae-mil-eoss-da. 'sa-in-i-na jom, hae-jwo-yo.'
story.en: Recognizing him even behind the mask, she widened her eyes. '...How are you even here—' Haneul avoided her gaze and pushed the album forward. 'Just — give me an autograph, would you.'

story.text: 앨범을 받아 든 손이 미세하게 떨렸다. 밖으로 나와 모자를 벗을 때까지, 하늘의 귀는 계속 빨갛게 물들어 있었다.
story.reading: ael-beom-eul bad-a deun son-i mi-se-ha-ge tteol-lyeoss-da. bakk-eu-ro na-wa mo-ja-reul beos-eul ttae-kka-ji, ha-neul-ui gwi-neun gye-sok ppal-gat-ge mul-deul-eo iss-eoss-da.
story.en: The hand holding the signed album trembled, ever so slightly. All the way outside, until he finally pulled off the cap, Haneul's ears stayed a deep, stubborn red.

words.example_en: I went to a fan-signing event for the first time today.
The line stretched all the way outside the bookstore.
It was a little awkward since it was his first time.
I got an autograph on the album.
He disguised himself with a cap and mask.

sentences.en: I went to a fan-signing event for the first time today.
The line was much longer than expected.
It felt a little awkward since it was his first time.
I received the autograph with trembling hands.
He pulled his cap down low and disguised himself.
